snippet.title: Death By Misstep | Horror + Rhythm + Stealth INDIE GAME– Official Trailer
snippet.description:
In Death By Misstep, a psychological horror video game with a cyberpunk setting, you play as Jessica, trapped on a luxury cruise ship turned into a nightmare.
When the ship’s security robots malfunction and start a merciless killing spree, you must breathe and move to the beat of the music to stay alive.

🎮 Key Features:

- Unique mix of horror, rhythm, and stealth gameplay.
- Breathe and synchronize with the ship’s songs so robots won’t detect you.
- Find a way to escape the cruise before it’s too late.
- Uncover Jessica’s terrifying backstory and the dark secrets of the Samos Cruise.

🔔 Add to your Steam Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2645730/Death_By_Misstep/

📌 Follow us: https://x.com/DeathByMisstep
